facts.fact: The National Planning Commission's MIP-1 2021-2022 progress report says the Malawi Digital Economy Strategy was 'finalised and awaits Cabinet approval' and is 'yet to be approved by cabinet'; the report gives no event date, so its published date (February 2023) is used.
